title: Parachute Mode: compact trace + cost surface deferral and acceptance criteria
creator: Sofia Li
description: We need to reduce the initial surface of the Console's Observability page to meet the release timeline while preserving the most actionable capability for customers building against Redwood. This ticket captures the decision to cut or defer nonessential visualizations from the primary dashboards, introduce a "parachute mode" graceful-degrade for traces under budget constraints, and define the acceptance criteria for the compact cost breakdown widget we will ship in the MVP. Rationale: shipping a tight, focused surface reduces integration work, reduces telemetry storage needs, and avoids shipping complex backend sampling before we have robust backwards-compatibility for route-level cost attribution.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Compact cost widget present on Insights landing: shows top 5 routes by spend and token count with 24h/7d toggle; no sampling required.
2) Tracing view shipped in parachute mode: full trace waterfall available only for top 3 error-prone routes; all other traces show collapsed span-summary with link to request drilldown.
3) Dashboard card load time < 600ms p95 on standard staging traffic; falling back to lightweight summary successfully when backend trace index is experiencing >20% query latency.
4) Rollout flags implemented: feature flag 'insights.compact_surface' gated per-org; ability to revert to previous surface in < 30 minutes without client migration.
5) Acceptance tests and QA checklist documented in linked PRD and passing in CI (unit + e2e smoke).
decisions:
- Defer heatmap and per-model cost attribution to next release due to backend index work.
- Ship a single compact cost card instead of multiple microcards to reduce telemetry overhead.
- Implement 'parachute mode' on the trace backend: reduce trace expansion, surface span summaries, and route-level sampling when query latency or cost thresholds are exceeded.
- Prioritize a robust flagging + rollback path over adding additional visualizations.
risks:
- Users with advanced cost needs may be dissatisfied; we mitigate with documentation and a simple export CSV.
- Parachute mode might mask root cause for rare high-latency events; mitigation: keep an audit log of suppressed traces and surface a 'request for full trace' flow for SREs.
- Feature flagging complexity across Dedicated/Private deployments; requires coordination with Eng and Security for safe rollout.
